name: Jade Mountain
positioning: Hillside resort designed by its architect-owner, set above the 600-acre Anse Chastanet beachfront estate in St. Lucia, with private infinity pool sanctuaries facing the Pitons and the Caribbean Sea
best_for: Couples who want a private infinity pool sanctuary with Pitons views
Travelers who want spa treatments, yoga and guided hikes alongside beach and reef time

facts.text: Jade Mountain sits above the 600-acre Anse Chastanet beachfront estate in St. Lucia.
Jade Mountain was designed by its architect-owner, Nick Troubetzkoy.
The sanctuaries have unobstructed views of the Pitons and the Caribbean Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The infinity pools are surfaced entirely in one-of-a-kind glass tiles designed specifically for Jade Mountain.
The infinity pools are lit at night by fibre optics that can cycle through colours or hold one shade.
The bathrooms have an open floor design that makes them part of the sanctuary.
The Jade Mountain Club, wrapped around a colorful infinity pool, caters exclusively to resident guests and serves Chef Allen Susser's Jade Cuisine.
The spa menu includes classic body and beauty treatments as well as Ayurvedic and holistic services.
Yoga classes by resident instructors are non-competitive and open to complete beginners and more advanced students.
Guests can visit the resort's Emerald Estate, where organic produce including mango, avocado, guava and cocoa is grown.
The resort is in the south of the island, within easy reach of the rainforest, Botanical Gardens, Drive-In Volcano and Sulphur Springs.
The team can arrange a guided hike up the Gros Piton.

highlights.text: Each sanctuary is reached by its own bridge leading to a private infinity pool sanctuary, set among rugged stone columns.
Each ensuite infinity pool has a unique design in both colour and shape.
The chromatherapy whirlpool tubs are for one or two people and sit on a pedestal for panoramic views while bathing.
Spa treatments are available in the privacy of the guest's infinity pool sanctuary or at the Kai en Ciel spa.
At the resort's Chocolate Lab, chocolate is produced from organically grown cocoa on the property.

considerations.text: Jade Mountain sits above the beachfront estate; the Anse Chastanet and Anse Mamin beaches are a short walk away.
Kai en Ciel, the spa at Jade Mountain, has two air-conditioned rooms plus hair, manicure and pedicure stations.
A 10% service charge is added to all spa treatments.
